close_reason: Design-validated: review confirmed the existing shape is correct. No code change required. Closing to reduce backlog noise; the docstring + test coverage already document the invariant.
description: src/ws/mod.rs:25-36 — WsRequestFrame wraps JmapRequest with #[serde(rename = "@type")] and #[serde(flatten)] inner. Result: one to_string() call produces the wire-correct frame in a single pass. The naive alternative — serialize JmapRequest to Value, mutate to insert @type, serialize again — does two passes plus a Value allocation. Documented as 'settled' in AGENTS.md design constraints. Defend against any 'just use to_value' refactor.
title: WsRequestFrame with serde(flatten) avoids a double-serialize round trip
